_what: One reconstruction run. Copy to <run dir>/recon_config.json, fill every field, and pass its path as the specifics. Every script reads it through RECON_CONFIG.

_fields.subject: what is thought lost, in the record's own words, with the issue number and the user's verbatim order
_fields.repo: the git repository the code lives in
_fields.path_regex: Python regex over ABSOLUTE file paths selecting the files in scope; it also selects the Bash commands that name them
_fields.path_aliases: pairs [old_prefix, new_prefix] of repo-relative prefixes for a file that moved, so its history is read under both spellings
_fields.from / to: the window, YYYY-MM-DD inclusive; ops outside it are still read, because a later edit is what proves an earlier one superseded
_fields.out_dir: the run directory, in the session scratchpad; the ONLY place the agent writes
_fields.transcripts_root: where the Claude Code transcripts live; they hold exact bytes from the day the earliest one starts
_fields.priority_subjects: the specific fixes to answer for first, each in the words the record uses
_fields.journal_axis: the repo axis journal KEYED the subject's entries by: a registered project's registered name (soma-prolog), otherwise its monorepo path (knowledge/carton-mcp)
_fields.base_ref / cutoff: left null; the agent sets them after classification to the commit just before the loss and that commit's time
_fields.scratch_key_regex: optional regex over the TEXT of Writes outside the repo (scratchpads, /tmp): the scripts that did the real work and were never committed
_fields.copy_checks: optional [[repo_relative_path, other_copy_abs_path], ...]: surviving copies a recovered file must equal byte for byte
_fields.installed_pairs: optional [[repo_dir_abs, copy_dir_abs, repo_relative_root], ...]: installed or vendored copies that may still hold lost code
